reconnect.intro.subtitle:
Reconnecting a device can help make it reachable or resolve issues you’re experiencing with the device.

Use the QR code on the device. If it has no QR code, follow the instructions.
reconnect.intro.title: Reconnect your $productName$
reconnect.noQRCode.subtitle: Are you sure? Reconnecting your device type via a QR code enhances the security of your system. If you have a QR code, tap the arrow to go back.
reconnect.noQRCode.title: Reconnect without a QR code
reconnect.scanQRCode.banner.notThisAcces: Scan the QR code of $deviceName$ to reconnect.
reconnect.scanQRCode.banner.unrecognised: This isn't a Hue QR code. Please scan another one.
reconnect.scanQRCode.subtitle: To reconnect your device to your Bridge, you will need to rescan the device's QR code.
reconnect.scanQRCode.title: Scan the QR code on your $productName$
reconnect.selectBridge.notSameBridgeWarn: Reconnecting $deviceName$ to another Bridge will remove any existing behaviours affecting lights, plugs or chimes. You can configure them again after reconnecting. Security settings will not be affected.
reconnect.selectBridge.title: Choose Bridge to reconnect
reconnect.tap.switches.steps.first: Reconnect your Tap switch(es) <emph>one by one</emph> with the following steps.
reconnect.tap.switches.steps.second.butt: To reconnect the Tap switch(es), firmly press and hold the <emph>first button</emph> of the Tap switch for <emph>10 seconds</emph>, then release.
To reconnect the Tap switch(es), firmly press and hold the <emph>second button</emph> of the Tap switch for <emph>10 seconds</emph>, then release.
To reconnect the Tap switch(es), firmly press and hold the <emph>third button</emph> of the Tap switch for <emph>10 seconds</emph>, then release.
To reconnect the Tap switch(es), firmly press and hold the <emph>fourth button</emph> of the Tap switch for <emph>10 seconds</emph>, then release.
reconnect.tap.switches.steps.third: After that, firmly <emph>press</emph> the button once more to verify the connection.
reconnect.tap.switches.title: Reconnect Tap switch(es)
